tagline: Defend Earth from the chimp Trasho and his star troop! Slide to dodge coconuts, destroy the formation and beat all 10 levels.
termsBody: This game runs entirely offline and collects no personal data. Your name, language, score and progress are saved only on your device and are deleted if you uninstall the game.
adDesc: One-time purchase. Removes all ads forever.
adNote: Reference price. The final price is shown by the store for your region.
winPhrase: The galaxy is free. Long live the Banana King!
